front.title: The ipn.arpa Zone and IPN DNS Operations

abstract.t: This document requests the creation of ipn.arpa, an infrastructure DNS namespace for the IPN node identifiers used by the Bundle Protocol (BP). Each Fully Qualified Node Number has a canonical name of the form N.A.ipn.arpa, where A is the Allocator Identifier and N is the Node Number. A BP Agent can query directly beneath that name for records specified by a convergence-layer discovery binding, such as SRV or SVCB records. The DNS records identify convergence-layer endpoints advertised for reaching a destination, including relays.
